message: 追求・問いつめたくて

name: Synn
message: 「That's the girl I ran into at the shopping district before.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What the heck is she doing in a place like this?」
She looks like she's searching for someone, though I wonder if she's a student at this academy.

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry, I didn't mean to startle you.」

name: Young Girl
message: 「*Shiver, shiver*... D-Do you need something from me...?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I don't really need anything, but... do you have some business at the academy?」

name: Young Girl
message: 「W-Why would you say such a thing?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, from the looks of it, you don't seem to be one of our students, and, uh... you're sticking out like a sore thumb.」

name: Young Girl
message: 「N-No way... Even though I was supposed to be hiding quietly out of sight...」

name: Synn
message: 「You just kind of looked like you were.」

name: Young Girl
message: 「You... You're no ordinary human, are you?」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Someone who can read minds... If I recall, you are what's known as an esper!」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Hawawawa! I knew I got it wrong!」

name: Young Girl
message: 「If only I had \{that|\s12\s12}, this wouldn't have happened」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Uu... However, I cannot afford to cause any more of a commotion」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's someone I know, I can go get them for you?」
The moment I accidentally grabbed her slender arm--
She got away from me once again.
